Package edu.secourse.patientportal.models

Class Doctor

java.lang.Object
edu.secourse.patientportal.models.User
edu.secourse.patientportal.models.Doctor
public class Doctor extends User
Represents a doctor within the patient portal system.

This class extends the abstract User class and adds a unique doctor-specific auto-incrementing identifier.
The ID is only incremented when integer boundary safety checks pass.
